agentFallback.hint: When no API key is saved for these helpers, run one agent turn instead so they work on a subscription. Off by default — follow-ups fire after every reply, so this costs a turn each time.
agentFallback.label: Use an agent turn when no API key is set

assistanceModel.description: Which model these helpers call. Defaults to a cheap model on your chat provider — set one here if that provider has no API key saved.
assistanceModel.heading: Assistance model

description: LLM help for writing your messages — enhancement, inline completion, and suggestions.

enhance.hint: Rewrite or vary your draft with a model, from the wand in the message box.
enhance.label: Prompt enhancement

followUps.hint: Suggest follow-up messages after the assistant replies.
followUps.label: Follow-up suggestions

ghostText.hint: Show a dim AI continuation as you type; press Tab to accept, Alt+\ to ask the agent for one. Off by default.
ghostText.label: Inline autocomplete

ghostTextLocal.hint: Complete from your own history and commands without calling a model.
ghostTextLocal.label: Local suggestions only

starters.hint: Suggest opening prompts on the empty chat screen.
starters.label: AI starter prompts
